# Pinned dependencies for .github/scripts/check-expiry.py
#
# Versions are pinned to exact releases. Dependabot tracks updates via
# the `pip` ecosystem entry in `.github/dependabot.yml` and opens a
# weekly grouped PR with bumps + a security PR per CVE.
#
# When updating manually:
#   pip install --upgrade pip-tools
#   pip-compile --upgrade --resolver=backtracking \
#       --output-file=.github/scripts/requirements.txt \
#       .github/scripts/requirements.in
# (We don't currently ship `requirements.in` because the dep set is
# minimal; if it grows, switch to that two-file pattern.)

pyjwt==2.10.1          # JWT for App Store Connect ES256 auth
cryptography==46.0.7   # ES256 signing backend for pyjwt
pyyaml==6.0.2          # config parsing
requests==2.33.0       # HTTP client
